name: The Phantom Agent
source:
When a new threat aims for world domination, it's up to you, GAIA's best agent, to save the globe from plunging into ultimate chaos. Good luck.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Phantom_Agent]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当新的威胁企图统治世界时，盖亚最好的特工你就需要拯救地球，使其免于陷入终极混乱。祝你好运。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Phantom_Agent]Choices Wikia[/url]]
